description: This is a Java test class for the GenericKeyboard component in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It contains unit tests verifying keyboard behavior such as display modes, keyboard ID, and preview visibility settings.

classes.name: GenericKeyboardTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the GenericKeyboard component in the keyboard app.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by setting up context and keyboard extensions before each test.

methods.name: testDoNotShowPasswordTopRow
methods.description: Verifies that password keyboards do not show the password row, ensuring the primary code is -2.

methods.name: testKeyboardIdPassed
methods.description: Checks that the keyboard ID is correctly assigned and not equal to the default add-on ID.

methods.name: testFalseShowPreviewAtRoot
methods.description: Tests that the keyboard keys do not show previews when configured with false show preview at root.

methods.name: testTrueShowPreviewAtRoot
methods.description: Verifies that keys show previews when configured with true show preview at root.

methods.name: testNoShowPreviewAtRoot
methods.description: Ensures that keys do not show previews when configured with no show preview at root.
